seo.og_description: Discover the Little Marrakech: ancient red walls, vibrant craft souks, oasis palm groves, and authentic Souss hospitality.

hero_subtitle: The Grand Red Ramparts City, Authentic Berber Souks & Gateway to the High Atlas.

overview.title: Welcome to the Little Marrakech
overview.p1: Nicknamed "The Little Marrakech", Taroudant is a captivating historical gem nestled in the fertile Souss Valley, framed by the majestic High Atlas and Anti-Atlas mountains. Encircling the city are nearly 7 kilometers of intact 16th-century Saadian red-clay ramparts with grand bastions and monumental gates.
overview.p2: Far from mass tourism, Taroudant retains its genuine Berber soul. Whether you stroll through the lively Arab and Berber craft souks, ride a traditional horse-drawn carriage along the ramparts, or explore nearby lush oases like Tiout, Taroudant offers an unhurried, deeply authentic Moroccan experience.

places.title: Must-Visit Places in Taroudant
places.subtitle: Historical ramparts, artisan souks, artistic palaces, and green oases in the Souss region.

remparts.title: Les Remparts de Taroudant
remparts.desc: Nearly 7 km of magnificent 16th-century Saadian red-earth walls surrounding the old city.

souks.title: Le Souk Berbère & Souk Arabe
souks.desc: Renowned for authentic silver jewelry, terracotta pottery, leatherwork, and spices without pushy sales.

claudio_bravo.title: Palais Claudio Bravo
claudio_bravo.desc: Former museum-palace of the Hyperrealist Chilean painter, showcasing artwork, exotic gardens, and sculptures.

assarag.title: Place Assarag
assarag.desc: The lively main square where locals meet at cafes, enjoying mint tea and street performances in the evening.

kasbah.title: La Kasbah de Taroudant
kasbah.desc: An ancient royal quarter built in the 16th century, holding quiet residential alleys and lush gardens.

tanneries.title: Tanneries de Taroudant
tanneries.desc: Located near Bab Taghoumt, discovering traditional artisan methods for leather processing.

tiout.title: Oasis & Kasbah de Tiout
tiout.desc: A lush palm grove 30 km away, topped by an ancient hilltop kasbah overlooking thousands of date palms.

hossoun.title: Jardin Dar al Hossoun
hossoun.desc: Subtropical garden with hundreds of rare plant species, peacocks, and eco-architecture in raw earth.

bab_kasbah.title: Porte Bab El-Kasbah
bab_kasbah.desc: The most impressive and ornate gate of the city's ramparts, surrounded by gardens and orange trees.

itinerary.title: Suggested 3-Day Itinerary
itinerary.subtitle: A comprehensive 3-day guide to discover Taroudant, its ancient ramparts, craft souks, and lush surrounding oases.

detailed_itinerary.day1_md: Start early with a traditional horse-drawn carriage (calèche) along the 7km loop of 16th-century red-earth ramparts. Stop at monumental gates like Bab El-Kasbah and Bab Sedra.
detailed_itinerary.day1_a: Afternoon — Souk Berbère, Souk Arabe & Tanneries
detailed_itinerary.day1_ad: Explore the artisan lanes for silver jewelry, terracotta pottery, and leatherwork. Visit the traditional tanneries near Bab Taghoumt to see age-old leathercraft methods.
detailed_itinerary.day1_e: Evening — Place Assarag Sunset & Mint Tea
detailed_itinerary.day1_ed: Gather at Place Assarag as dusk falls. Sip fresh mint tea on a café terrace while watching local street musicians and performers, followed by a quiet dinner in a riad courtyard.
detailed_itinerary.day2_md: Take a 30-minute excursion to the lush Tiout Oasis. Walk under thousands of date palms and climb up to the hilltop Kasbah for panoramic views over the Souss Valley.
detailed_itinerary.day2_a: Afternoon — Palais Claudio Bravo & Botanical Gardens
detailed_itinerary.day2_ad: Head to the former palace-museum of Claudio Bravo to admire hyperrealist art, sculptures, and exotic gardens, or visit Dar al Hossoun's subtropical eco-garden.
detailed_itinerary.day2_ed: Enjoy an authentic Berber dinner featuring dishes enhanced with locally produced culinary Argan oil, fresh almonds, and Souss tagines.
detailed_itinerary.day3_m: Morning — Excursion to Taliouine or Tizi n'Test
detailed_itinerary.day3_md: Travel east toward Taliouine to visit saffron cooperatives in the Sirwa mountains, or drive up the scenic Tizi n'Test pass for mountain landscapes and High Atlas views.
detailed_itinerary.day3_a: Afternoon — Relaxed Medina Stroll & Local Hammam
detailed_itinerary.day3_ad: Return to the medina for a peaceful afternoon. Unwind with a traditional Moroccan hammam and massage with Argan oil, then pick up local spices and saffron as souvenirs.
detailed_itinerary.day3_e: Evening — Final Sunset Over the Atlas
detailed_itinerary.day3_ed: Spend your final evening on a rooftop terrace, watching the sunset glow on the red walls with the snow-capped High Atlas peaks in the distance.
